evidence.why: Lifecycle registration, exact signature, first-match traversal, and loop-flag request.
Unsigned callback payload and light-object dispatch.
ORs permitted flags into non-null animation objects.

reason: The nullary lifecycle callback searches the global list, processes only the first classifier-0xC object, and applies AOBJ_LOOP throughout its light chain. This configures looping, rather than independently starting stopped animations.
